Title: Generally Available: Azure Resource Manager API for vCore-based Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB

Body.Content:
Now generally available: vCore-based Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB with an API for cluster management, offering you scalable, high-performance clusters on Azure. With this release, you can programmatically manage your vCore-based Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB clusters with ease through the Azure Resource Manager (ARM) API and Terraform.  

Learn more.
